fn computeSum(w: Int, h: Int, k: Int) -> Int
  requires (w >= 3)
  requires (h >= 3)
  requires (k >= 0)
  requires ((w - (4 * k)) >= 3)
  requires ((h - (4 * k)) >= 3)
  ensures (result == (if (k == 0) then 0 else (((w * 2) + ((h - 2) * 2)) + computeSum((w - 4), (h - 4), (k - 1)))))
  effects pure
  example (computeSum(3, 3, 0) == 0)
  example (computeSum(7, 7, 1) == 24)
